shortDefinition: The Bureau service that turns Panel Builder manifests into executable workflows.

children.text: Template Compiler runs in the MANAGER Pearl. When an admin publishes a panel, the compiler validates JSONLogic, datasets, and field types, then emits a workflow definition for activation.
Catches schema errors before templates reach users.
Outputs GraphQL-ready definitions for Process Catalog.
Part of MANAGER Pearl services alongside WorkflowRegistry and TelemetrySink.
